boards.title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain California State University-Stanislaus
boards.description: Ten under-21-safe Turlock food stops with late availability documented by current official location pages. Confirm holiday hours and distinguish drive-through from lobby access before leaving campus.

cards.title: Round-the-Clock Diner Stop
cards.subtitle: Open 24 hours on Lander Avenue
cards.notes: Use this south-Turlock diner when the hour is uncertain; check the official location page before relying on holiday access.
cards.short_summary: A continuously open diner serving breakfast, lunch, and dinner.
cards.evidence_claim: Denny’s official location page identifies the restaurant at 1991 Lander Avenue, lists it as open 24 hours every day, and says it welcomes children.
cards.access_notes: The official page lists restaurant service as open 24 hours daily; contact the location to confirm holiday hours.

cards.title: All-Night Geer Road Drive-Through
cards.subtitle: Twenty-four-hour service near the campus side of Turlock
cards.notes: Choose this Geer Road counter for overnight takeout, and verify whether the lobby or only the drive-through is operating.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour fast-food option on the principal commercial road west of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official page identifies the 2700 Geer Road restaurant and lists its drive-through as open 24 hours seven days a week.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Turlock, CA — 2700 Geer Rd
cards.access_notes: Drive-through hours are listed as 24 hours daily; lobby access may differ, so check the page before walking over.

cards.title: West Main Street Until 3
cards.subtitle: Drive-through service through 3 a.m.
cards.notes: Use the drive-through for the documented late window; the official page shows dine-in ending earlier than vehicle service.
cards.short_summary: A West Main Street takeout stop with a consistent 3 a.m. closing time.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official location page lists the 2050 West Main Street drive-through from 7 a.m. to 3 a.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Turlock, CA — 2050 W Main St
cards.access_notes: Drive-through service is listed until 3 a.m. daily; the displayed dine-in schedule ends at 11 p.m.

cards.entity_name: Taco Bell — 3606 North Golden State Boulevard
cards.title: North Golden State Late Window
cards.subtitle: Open past midnight every night
cards.notes: Head north for takeout after midnight, noting that Friday and Saturday extend one hour later than the weekday schedule.
cards.short_summary: A north-Turlock drive-through closing at 1 or 2 a.m., depending on the night.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Taco Bell page lists drive-through service until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday at 3606 North Golden State Boulevard.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Turlock, CA — 3606 N Golden State Blvd
cards.access_notes: Drive-through closes at 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 2 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 2601 Geer Road
cards.title: Twenty-Four-Hour Campus-Side Drive-Through
cards.subtitle: Continuous drive-through service on Geer Road
cards.notes: Treat this as a vehicle-service option overnight; review the official listing because no matching late lobby schedule is shown.
cards.short_summary: A round-the-clock drive-through on the commercial corridor nearest campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box’s official page identifies 2601 Geer Road and displays drive-through hours of 4 a.m. to 4 a.m. every day, indicating continuous service.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 2601 Geer Rd, Turlock
cards.access_notes: The drive-through schedule runs 4 a.m. to 4 a.m. daily, effectively 24 hours; do not assume overnight lobby access.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 1951 Lander Road
cards.title: Lander Road All-Night Window
cards.subtitle: Drive-through access around the clock
cards.notes: Use the drive-through after the lobby closes at 9 p.m.; confirm the posted schedule before making the longer trip south.
cards.short_summary: A 24-hour drive-through paired with an earlier-closing lobby.
cards.evidence_claim: The official Jack in the Box page lists 1951 Lander Road and shows drive-through hours of 4 a.m. to 4 a.m. daily, with the lobby closing at 9 p.m.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 1951 Lander Rd, Turlock
cards.access_notes: Drive-through service is effectively 24 hours daily; the official page lists lobby service only until 9 p.m.

cards.entity_name: Jack in the Box — 100 North Golden State Boulevard
cards.title: Downtown-Edge Weekend Extension
cards.subtitle: Drive-through until 3 a.m. Friday and Saturday
cards.notes: Save this address for a weekend run, when its drive-through stays two hours later than the Sunday–Thursday schedule.
cards.short_summary: A central Turlock drive-through with extended Friday and Saturday hours.
cards.evidence_claim: Jack in the Box’s official page lists the 100 North Golden State Boulevard drive-through until 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Jack in the Box — 100 N Golden State Blvd, Turlock
cards.access_notes: Drive-through closes at 1 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 3 a.m. Friday–Saturday; the lobby closes earlier.

cards.title: Geer Road Midnight Cutoff
cards.subtitle: Restaurant and drive-through open until midnight
cards.notes: Plan this as a before-midnight stop: both the dining room and drive-through share the same closing time on the official page.
cards.short_summary: A near-campus Geer Road option with a nightly midnight closing.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official page lists both restaurant and drive-through hours at 2395 Geer Road from 6:30 a.m. to midnight every day.
cards.access_notes: Restaurant and drive-through service are listed until midnight seven days a week; holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Monte Vista Midnight Stop
cards.subtitle: Nightly service through midnight
cards.notes: Use this west-side location when traveling along Monte Vista Avenue, allowing time to order before its firm midnight closing.
cards.short_summary: A west-Turlock restaurant and drive-through available until midnight nightly.
cards.evidence_claim: Wendy’s official location page lists restaurant and drive-through hours at 3450 West Monte Vista Avenue from 6:30 a.m. to midnight daily.
cards.source_title: Wendy’s Monte Vista — 3450 W Monte Vista Ave
cards.access_notes: The restaurant and drive-through are listed until midnight every day; the page notes that holiday hours may vary.

cards.title: Friday-and-Saturday Pizza Cutoff
cards.subtitle: Delivery and carryout until midnight on weekends
cards.notes: Reserve this for Friday or Saturday and place the order early; weekday and Sunday service ends at 11 p.m.
cards.short_summary: A weekend-only midnight option for pizza delivery or carryout.
cards.evidence_claim: Pizza Hut’s official page identifies 920 Lander Avenue and lists delivery and carryout until midnight Friday and Saturday, with 11 p.m. closing on other days.
cards.access_notes: Delivery and carryout close at midnight Friday–Saturday and 11 p.m. Sunday–Thursday; delivery hours may vary.

warnings: Late access is frequently drive-through or takeout rather than lobby service; verify the official page before departure.
Holiday hours and delivery availability can differ from the regular schedules documented here.
